player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I did not update the `edges` in my graph to reflect the connections I discovered (e.g., the edge between Guest room and Sauna), and I stopped prematurely without verifying if all reachable rooms were visited. Next time, I will strictly update the `edges` dictionary for every move to record the path taken, maintain a mental (or explicit) set of visited rooms, and only output "DONE" when the set of visited rooms matches the total number of unique rooms encountered so far, ensuring no unvisited neighbors remain.
